question: According to the Agricultural and Processed food products Export Development Authority (APEDA) 2020-2021, which state of India has the first rank in grapes production?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to APEDA, **Maharashtra is the top state in India for grape** production: 

 
 
• **Maharashtra**
 
• 70.67%
 
• Karnataka
 
• 24.49%
 
• Tamil Nadu
 
• 1.43%
 
• Andhra Pradesh
 
• 1.34%
 
 
 
• The cultivation and harvesting of grapes are called viticulture.
 
• Viticulture is the speciality of the Mediterranian region.
 
• The best quality wines in the world with distinctive flavours are produced from this region such as Port wine is famous in Portugal, Sherry in Southern Spain, etc. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 
 
Terminology

 
 
 
Explanation

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
Horticulture

 
 
 
The branch of plant agriculture deals with garden crops, generally fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants.

 
 
 

 
 
Sericulture

 
 
 
 Commercial rearing of silkworms for the production of silk.

 
 
 

 
 
Pisciculture

 
 
 
 The rearing and controlled breeding of fishes.
